Stage 5 · Java foundations

Polymorphism: One Remote

Single Animal remote, endless cartridges. Loops never rewrite.

⏱ 15 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Same button, many voices

Cartridges multiply; remote never changes.

🎮

Universal remote. speak() fits the Animal socket. Dog cartridge → Woof. Cat → Meow. Parrot joins later — loop UNCHANGED. But only SHARED buttons exist: fetch() isn’t on it!

ProgramRead each line in order
Animal[] zoo = { new Dog(), new Cat() }; // cartridges in
for (Animal a : zoo) {
  a.speak(); // same button, two voices
}
// Later: Parrot with "Squawk!" joins the zoo.
// The loop above stays UNCHANGED.

One array, one loop, two voices — plus future-proofing.

a = Dog
